text:
Express shipping is **$14.95**. It's never free, including for Leafy Plus members.

Delivery times depend on your zone: next business day in Zone 1 (under 300 miles from our nearest greenhouse) and 2 business days in Zone 2 (300-1,000 miles). Express isn't available in Zone 3 (over 1,000 miles, plus remote and island addresses), and it isn't available for XL plants, which ship Standard only.

Live plants also ship Monday-Wednesday only, so those days apply before the transit time starts.
